market_question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (LOW) $40 by end of June?
reasoning: WTI crude currently trades around $65–75; a drop to $40 represents a ~40% decline. Options markets imply roughly a 10% probability of the front-month settlement being below $40 at the June 2026 expiry, and the probability of touching that level on any day is likely higher. Even after accounting for the daily settlement barrier and limited monitoring, a 5% chance appears far more realistic than the market’s 1.1%. The edge is therefore strongly positive for ‘Yes’.
evidence_points: WTI front-month futures are near $70 in early 2025
OTM puts for June 2026 WTI show ~10% probability of final settlement below $40
Historical crude oil drawdowns of this magnitude have occurred during recessions and demand shocks
